home.practice_overload_blurb: Tap a capacitor to charge it. A full one bursts into its neighbours, and one chain of ten beats two of five.
overload.title: Overload
overload.how_to: Tap a capacitor to add one charge. At four it bursts and passes one charge to each neighbour above, below, left and right; a neighbour that reaches four bursts next. A chain of n bursts scores n times n. Taps are scarce: you hold five and one comes back every two and a half seconds. A tap that bursts nothing still charges, so spend one to join two clusters before you set them off.
overload.how_to_keyboard: Arrows or WASD move the cursor. Space or enter taps.
overload.streak_note: A chain of four or more builds a streak that multiplies every chain, a quarter more each time, up to triple. A shorter chain breaks it. A tap that bursts nothing does not.
overload.refund_note: Every four bursts in a chain give a tap back.
overload.hint_note: Practice rounds mark a tap worth making when you pause: a ring for a chain, a plus for a charge that sets one up.
overload.draw_note: The row under the bank shows the draw: a band of chain sizes. A chain whose bursts land in it scores more, and the next draw is asked for. A chain past the band is only a chain, so count before you charge again.
overload.stage.bursts_intro: Tap a capacitor at three and it bursts into its neighbours. Read the chain before you tap: a chain of n scores n times n.
overload.stage.streak_intro: Chains of four or more build a streak that multiplies every chain. A shorter one breaks it, so charge first. Boosters pass two charges.
overload.stage.full_intro: Under the bank the ship asks for a chain of a size. Land a chain in that band for more, then the next is asked for. Past it pays nothing extra.
overload.legend_booster: Booster, with four lugs. It passes two charges to each neighbour when it bursts.
overload.legend_ring: A capacitor has one hole for each charge it holds. A capacitor goes when its charge plus its bursting neighbours reach four, and it bursts once in a chain.
overload.legend_draw: The draw, under the bank: the chain sizes the ship asks for, and what a chain of one of them pays. With the mouse over a capacitor at three, or the cursor on it, the row says how long its chain is and whether it meets the draw.
studio.preset.overload_many_boosters: Boosters everywhere: one capacitor in five
studio.preset.overload_hot_bank: A hot bank: fresh capacitors come in fuller
studio.preset.overload_cold_bank: A cold bank: fresh capacitors come in nearly empty
studio.preset.overload_flat_streak: No streak: every chain at 100 percent
studio.preset.overload_free_taps: Taps come back fast: one every half second
studio.preset.overload_big_bank: A big bank: eight by nine
studio.preset.overload_ten_taps: Ten taps, one minute: none given back
